job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) with strong ex…

tailoring.headline: Senior Tech E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] ... looking for an experienced Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) with strong ex…
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in your technical leadership opportunity, bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce platform engineering experience gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Having successfully designed and delivered complex backend systems, headless architectures, and high-performance API integrations, I am eager to bring my technical depth to your team.

bullets.label: Architecture & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs to support modern storefront architectures and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Engineering
bullets.text: Engineered core e-commerce platform modules including promotions, order management (OMS), catalog synchronization, and complex PIM-to-platform data pipelines across enterprise landscapes.

bullets.label: API Development & Data Flows
bullets.text: Built scalable RESTful APIs, customized Interceptors and Converters, and optimized data integration workflows between ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production troubleshooting, and provided technical guidance to developers within fast-paced international agile delivery environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with your technical goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am excited to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce engineering experience to Janaki Sadineni. My strong background in building scalable platform architectures, headless API integrations, and robust backend systems aligns directly with your technical requirements.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and API development experience to drive robust architecture and scalable platform engineering for your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an experienced e-commerce developer with 5+ years building scalable platforms, REST APIs, and backend architectures at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed your opening and would love to discuss how my expertise can support your team. Best regards, Kranti
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Tech Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your open position. With over 5 years of professional experience in designing, building, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in backend engineering and headless architectures.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
